description: Bellingham, WA -- On Thursday, June 4, 2026, State Representative Joe Timmons will officially kick off his re-election campaign with supporters, friends, neighbors, and community leaders at Stemma West Brewery in Bellingham as he launches his campaign for a third term representing Washington's 42nd Legislative District. House Speaker Laurie Jinkins will join Joe as a special guest for the event, which will celebrate the progress made for Whatcom County and outline the work ahead to strengthen...
